content.text:
`slugify('Crème Brûlée')` now returns `creme-brulee`. The test suite passes, 3 of 3.

The fix is in `slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters with `normalize('NFKD')` and strips the combining marks before lowercasing and replacing non-alphanumerics with dashes. I also added trimming of leading and trailing dashes, because the existing comment promised that and the code didn't do it: `'Hello World!'` was returning `hello-world-`.

I added two tests in `test/slug.test.js`: one for accented words (`Crème Brûlée`, `Jalapeño Piñata`) and one for the dash trimming.

One limitation: letters that don't decompose, such as `Æ`, `Ø` and `Å`, still get treated as separators, so `Øl` becomes `l`. Fixing that needs an explicit mapping table, which I didn't add. Say if you want it.
